  1600	fn parse_projection_cursor(raw: &str) -> Option<ProjectionCursor> {
  1601	    let mut parts = raw.split(':');
  1602	    if parts.next()? != "sp1" {
  1603	        return None;
  1604	    }
  1605	    let epoch = parts.next()?;
  1606	    let session_hash = parts.next()?;
  1607	    let seq = parts.next()?.parse().ok()?;
  1608	    let epoch_bytes = epoch.as_bytes();
  1609	    let valid_epoch = epoch_bytes.len() == 36
  1610	        && epoch_bytes.iter().enumerate().all(|(index, byte)| {
  1611	            if matches!(index, 8 | 13 | 18 | 23) {
  1612	                *byte == b'-'
  1613	            } else {
  1614	                byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()
  1615	            }
  1616	        });
  1617	    if parts.next().is_some()
  1618	        || !valid_epoch
  1619	        || session_hash.len() != 16
  1620	        || !session_hash.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
  1621	    {
  1622	        return None;
  1623	    }
  1624	    Some(ProjectionCursor {
  1625	        prefix: format!("sp1:{epoch}:{session_hash}"),
  1626	        seq,
  1627	    })
  1628	}

  1630	fn projection_cursor_transition(current: &str, incoming: &str) -> CursorTransition {
  1631	    let (Some(current), Some(incoming)) = (
  1632	        parse_projection_cursor(current),
  1633	        parse_projection_cursor(incoming),
  1634	    ) else {
  1635	        return CursorTransition::Reset;
  1636	    };
  1637	    if current.prefix != incoming.prefix {
  1638	        CursorTransition::Reset
  1639	    } else if incoming.seq <= current.seq {
  1640	        CursorTransition::Duplicate
  1641	    } else if incoming.seq == current.seq.saturating_add(1) {
  1642	        CursorTransition::Next
  1643	    } else {

  1645	    }

  1920	fn prepare_projection_snapshot(
  1921	    detail: SessionDetail,
  1922	    projection: SessionProjection,
  1923	) -> Result<PreparedProjection, ProjectionPreparation> {
  1924	    if projection.version != 1
  1925	        || projection.lease_id.is_empty()
  1926	        || projection.lease_expires_ms <= 0
  1927	        || detail.persistence_revision != Some(projection.checkpoint_revision)
  1928	    {
  1929	        return Err(ProjectionPreparation::Invalid);
  1930	    }
  1931	    if let Some(checkpoint) = &projection.checkpoint {
  1932	        let revision = match checkpoint {
  1933	            SessionProjectionCheckpoint::Inline {
  1934	                persistence_revision,
  1935	                ..
  1936	            }
  1937	            | SessionProjectionCheckpoint::Refetch {
  1938	                persistence_revision,
  1939	            } => *persistence_revision,
  1940	        };
  1941	        if revision != projection.checkpoint_revision {
  1942	            return Err(ProjectionPreparation::Invalid);
  1943	        }
  1944	    }
  1945	    let final_cursor =
  1946	        parse_projection_cursor(&projection.cursor).ok_or(ProjectionPreparation::Invalid)?;
  1947	    if projection.pending_events.len() as u64 > final_cursor.seq {
  1948	        return Err(ProjectionPreparation::Invalid);
  1949	    }
  1950	    let mut expected_seq = final_cursor.seq - projection.pending_events.len() as u64;
  1951	    let (mut turns, mut pinned) =
  1952	        turns_from_session_transcript(detail.transcript.clone(), &detail.tool_context);
  1953	
  1954	    // The top-level refetch marker is already satisfied by this same canonical
  1955	    // GET. Inline checkpoints are an aligned normalized replacement.
  1956	    if let Some(checkpoint) = &projection.checkpoint {
  1957	        if let SessionProjectionCheckpoint::Inline { .. } = checkpoint {
  1958	            if let Some(replacement) = checkpoint_replacement(checkpoint)? {
  1959	                (turns, pinned) = replacement;
  1960	            }
  1961	        }
  1962	    }
  1963	
  1964	    for frame in &projection.pending_events {
  1965	        let parsed =
  1966	            parse_projection_cursor(&frame.cursor).ok_or(ProjectionPreparation::Invalid)?;
  1967	        expected_seq = expected_seq.saturating_add(1);
  1968	        if parsed.prefix != final_cursor.prefix || parsed.seq != expected_seq {
  1969	            return Err(ProjectionPreparation::Invalid);
  1970	        }
  1971	        match frame.source {
  1972	            SessionProjectionSource::Agent => {
  1973	                let event = serde_json::from_value::<AgentEvent>(frame.event.clone())
  1974	                    .map_err(|_| ProjectionPreparation::Invalid)?;
  1975	                if event.session_id() != Some(detail.id.as_str()) {
  1976	                    return Err(ProjectionPreparation::Invalid);
  1977	                }
  1978	                apply_projection_content(&mut turns, &mut pinned, &event);
  1979	            }
  1980	            SessionProjectionSource::Control => {
  1981	                // Folded permission state below is authoritative; reducing these
  1982	                // frames too would duplicate cards.
  1983	            }
  1984	            SessionProjectionSource::Checkpoint => {
  1985	                let checkpoint =
  1986	                    serde_json::from_value::<SessionProjectionCheckpoint>(frame.event.clone())
  1987	                        .map_err(|_| ProjectionPreparation::Invalid)?;
  1988	                if let Some(replacement) = checkpoint_replacement(&checkpoint)? {
  1989	                    (turns, pinned) = replacement;
  1990	                }
  1991	            }
  1992	        }
  1993	    }
  1994	    if expected_seq != final_cursor.seq {
  1995	        return Err(ProjectionPreparation::Invalid);
  1996	    }
  1997	
  1998	    let decode_state = |value: &Option<Value>| {
  1999	        value
  2000	            .as_ref()
  2001	            .and_then(|value| serde_json::from_value::<AgentEvent>(value.clone()).ok())
  2002	            .filter(|event| event.session_id() == Some(detail.id.as_str()))
  2003	    };
  2004	    let permissions = projection
  2005	        .state
  2006	        .pending_permissions
  2007	        .iter()
  2008	        .filter_map(|value| permission_from_projection(value, &detail.id))
  2009	        .collect();
  2010	
  2011	    Ok(PreparedProjection {
  2012	        active_turn: decode_state(&projection.state.active_turn),
  2013	        last_turn_finished: decode_state(&projection.state.last_turn_finished),
  2014	        model_rerouted: decode_state(&projection.state.model_rerouted),
  2015	        browser_active: projection.state.browser_active,
  2016	        detail,
  2017	        turns,
  2018	        pinned,
  2019	        cursor: projection.cursor,
  2020	        lease_id: projection.lease_id,
  2021	        permissions,
  2022	    })
  2023	}

  1600	fn parse_projection_cursor(raw: &str) -> Option<ProjectionCursor> {
  1601	    let mut parts = raw.split(':');
  1602	    if parts.next()? != "sp1" {
  1603	        return None;
  1604	    }
  1605	    let epoch = parts.next()?;
  1606	    let session_hash = parts.next()?;
  1607	    let seq = parts.next()?.parse().ok()?;
  1608	    let epoch_bytes = epoch.as_bytes();
  1609	    let valid_epoch = epoch_bytes.len() == 36
  1610	        && epoch_bytes.iter().enumerate().all(|(index, byte)| {
  1611	            if matches!(index, 8 | 13 | 18 | 23) {
  1612	                *byte == b'-'
  1613	            } else {
  1614	                byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()
  1615	            }
  1616	        });
  1617	    if parts.next().is_some()
  1618	        || !valid_epoch
  1619	        || session_hash.len() != 16
  1620	        || !session_hash.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
  1621	    {
  1622	        return None;
  1623	    }
  1624	    Some(ProjectionCursor {
  1625	        prefix: format!("sp1:{epoch}:{session_hash}"),
  1626	        seq,
  1627	    })
  1628	}

# Implementation Plan

## Goal
Make `switch_session` perform an atomic, cursor-backed snapshot-plus-tail attachment on projection-capable daemons while preserving Voice Planner, legacy fallback, and the separate canvas ledger lane.

## Tasks

1. **Resolve the daemon component-state ambiguity before consuming `projection.state`**
   - File: `/private/tmp/ocean-os-session-projection-20260717/crates/ocean-daemon/src/session_projection.rs`
   - Changes:
     - Ensure `SessionProjectionState.components` is a complete authoritative registry at the checkpoint revision, including components reconstructed from canonical checkpoint `transcript`/`tool_context`.
     - Preserve unmount tombstones/effects so an empty component list unambiguously means “no components,” not “no component events this epoch.”
     - Do not make Surface guess whether an empty folded registry should erase components reconstructed from the canonical session.
   - Acceptance:
     - A component persisted before daemon restart remains present in a fresh projection attachment.
     - A later persisted unmount produces an authoritative empty registry.
     - Inline and refetch checkpoints yield the same component state.

2. **Add typed projection wire models and cursor validation**
   - File: `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs`
   - Changes:
     - Extend `SessionDetailResponse` with optional `projection`.
     - Add local serde mirrors for:
       - `SessionProjection`
       - `SessionProjectionFrame`
       - `SessionProjectionSource`
       - `SessionProjectionState`
       - inline/refetch checkpoint variants
     - Decode `persistence_revision` as `Option<u64>` so missing means an old daemon and `Some(0)` still identifies a projection-capable daemon.
     - Add a pure cursor parser returning `{prefix, seq}` for `sp1:<epoch>:<session-hash>:<seq>`.
     - Add a pure transition classifier:
       - same/older sequence: duplicate, ignore;
       - exactly `current + 1`: apply;
       - changed prefix or sequence gap: reset/refetch.
     - Add `ModelRerouted` and `Cancelled` wire handling needed by folded/tail state.
   - Acceptance:
     - Old session JSON responses still deserialize.
     - Malformed, changed-prefix, future-gap, duplicate, and consecutive cursors have explicit tested outcomes.

3. **Generalize EventSource ownership without weakening Voice Planner**
   - File: `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs`
   - Changes:
     - Generalize `PlannerStreamSources` into one session-generation owner containing:
       - legacy agent stream;
       - legacy permission stream;
       - projection stream;
       - canvas-only legacy stream.
     - Keep Planner lifecycle/readiness based exclusively on its legacy agent and permission streams.
     - Add one reset helper that closes every stored source before installing a new session/generation.
     - Register each source immediately after `EventSource::new`, while it is still `Connecting`, before awaiting `Open`.
     - Close the replaced source explicitly; never rely solely on generation guards.
     - Do not use the existing strict `monitor_stream_open` for projection transport. Native EventSource enters `CONNECTING` during the daemon’s periodic connection rotation and must be allowed to reconnect.
   - Acceptance:
     - Switching sessions closes all four possible transports immediately.
     - Voice Planner still requires the exact two legacy streams and preserves its current readiness/reconciliation ordering.
     - A stale connecting source cannot later replace or close the current generation.

4. **Replace `switch_session`’s concurrent hydration/connect race with an attachment sequencer**
   - File: `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs`
   - Changes:
     - Change `switch_session` from:
       1. select state;
       2. spawn snapshot;
       3. open live streams concurrently;
       to:
       1. select session state;
       2. increment generation and close old streams immediately;
       3. fetch `GET /v1/sessions/{id}`;
       4. reduce the response completely off-signal;
       5. install it in one Leptos batch after rechecking session/generation;
       6. only then open projection/canvas tails.
     - Split current hydration into:
       - `fetch_session_attachment`;
       - `build_projection_install`;
       - `install_projection_attachment`;
       - `install_legacy_snapshot`.
     - Compute the complete `turns`, pinned widgets, permissions, active state, model, browser state, and token/status state before mutating signals.
   - Acceptance:
     - No SSE reducer can mutate transcript state before its matching snapshot is installed.
     - A delayed response from the previous session/generation changes no signals.
     - UI observers never see a half-installed projection.

5. **Implement normative initial projection reduction**
   - File: `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs`
   - Changes:
     - Apply the daemon-defined precedence exactly:
       1. hydrate canonical `SessionDetail`;
       2. treat the top-level aligned checkpoint as the durable base;
       3. reduce `pending_events` once in cursor order;
       4. install folded state as authoritative replacements;
       5. start the tail after `projection.cursor`.
     - Inline checkpoint:
       - replace transcript/tool content through `turns_from_session_transcript`;
       - never append it onto existing content.
     - Top-level refetch checkpoint:
       - consider it already satisfied by the same fresh GET.
     - Pending refetch checkpoint:
       - abort installation and restart GET.
     - Reduce pending agent frames only for transcript/tool/checkpoint content.
     - Do not also reduce pending component, browser, lifecycle, reroute, or control frames; install those from `projection.state`.
     - Clear and rebuild component/pinned registries before installing authoritative component state.
     - Keep `active_decision_token` cleared. Pending permissions from another surface must not acquire decision authority.
   - Acceptance:
     - Snapshot plus pending frames produces the same state as replay through the snapshot cursor.
     - Component and permission frames are not applied twice.
     - Completed thinking hydrates from the canonical transcript; partial thinking comes only from pending/tail frames.

6. **Implement the projection EventSource tail**
   - File: `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs`
   - Changes:
     - Open:
       `/v1/agent/projection/events?session_id=<id>&after_cursor=<cursor>&lease_id=<lease>`
     - Subscribe to `session_projection` and `projection_reset`.
     - Store the EventSource before awaiting open.
     - For each frame:
       - verify generation/session;
       - verify `MessageEvent.last_event_id()` matches the frame cursor when present;
       - ignore duplicate/older frames;
       - require exactly the next sequence;
       - reduce agent/control/checkpoint tail frames normally.
     - Inline tail checkpoint replaces transcript/tool state.
     - Refetch checkpoint, cursor gap, prefix change, decode failure, or `projection_reset` closes the generation and repeats the GET attachment.
     - Let native EventSource reconnect through transient `CONNECTING`.
   - Acceptance:
     - A forced daemon connection rotation resumes through `Last-Event-ID` without closing the stored EventSource.
     - A retention/epoch/lease reset never falls through to live delivery.

7. **Keep SurfacePatch on an isolated legacy canvas lane**
   - File: `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs`
   - Changes:
     - In projection mode, open a second scoped legacy stream at `/v1/agent/events?session_id=<id>`.
     - Subscribe only to `surface_patch`.
     - Route directly to the canvas ledger signal/reducer; do not call the transcript/lifecycle reducer.
     - Store it in the same generation-owned source registry and close it on session reset.
     - Preserve its existing best-effort UUID replay behavior; do not advance or validate the transcript projection cursor from this lane.
   - Acceptance:
     - A legacy agent text/tool frame can never mutate transcript state while projection mode is active.
     - SurfacePatch remains visible without entering the content-journal cursor.

8. **Add bounded old-daemon fallback**
   - File: `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs`
   - Changes:
     - If `persistence_revision` is present but `projection` is absent, retry the snapshot a small bounded number of times to cover daemon bridge alignment.
     - If `persistence_revision` is absent, immediately classify the daemon as legacy.
     - After retry exhaustion:
       1. hydrate the legacy snapshot fully;
       2. verify generation/session;
       3. only then call the existing legacy `connect`.
     - Log a warning and expose a concise degraded status such as `connected · legacy sync`.
     - Never restore the old concurrent `load_session_snapshot(); connect();` ordering.
   - Acceptance:
     - Legacy hydration always precedes stream opening.
     - A projection-capable daemon that temporarily omits projection is retried before degradation.

9. **Proxy projection SSE and resume headers**
   - File: `crates/ocean-surface-proxy/src/main.rs`
   - Changes:
     - Add `GET /v1/agent/projection/events`.
     - Forward the full query unchanged.
     - Forward `Last-Event-ID` to the daemon.
     - Reuse the existing no-buffer SSE response headers/body streaming.
     - Also forward `Last-Event-ID` on `/v1/agent/events` so the canvas-only lane retains its existing replay opportunity.
   - Acceptance:
     - Browser/PWA reconnection through the proxy reaches the daemon with the native EventSource cursor.
     - Projection responses retain `text/event-stream`, `no-transform`, and no-buffer headers.

10. **Add regression and lifecycle tests**
    - File: `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs`
    - Tests:
      - old/new response decoding;
      - cursor duplicate/consecutive/gap/prefix behavior;
      - delayed stale snapshot rejection;
      - canonical → checkpoint → pending → folded-state precedence;
      - inline checkpoint replacement;
      - refetch-marker restart;
      - component/permission non-duplication;
      - folded active/terminal/reroute/browser installation;
      - projection reset invalidates the generation;
      - legacy fallback hydrates before connect;
      - SurfacePatch-only reducer cannot mutate transcript.
    - File: `crates/ocean-surface-proxy/src/main.rs`
    - Tests:
      - projection route exists;
      - query is preserved;
      - `Last-Event-ID` forwarding;
      - SSE no-buffer headers.
    - Acceptance:
      - Tests fail against the current concurrent `switch_session` implementation and pass after sequencing.

11. **Document and validate the contract**
    - Files:
      - `AGENTS.md`
      - `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` only if Surface transport architecture is documented there already
    - Changes:
      - Record snapshot-before-tail ordering, explicit reset behavior, legacy fallback, and independent SurfacePatch authority.
      - Do not copy Observatory contracts or add runtime authority to Surface.
    - Acceptance commands:
      - `cargo test -p ocean-surface-ui`
      - `cargo check -p ocean-surface-ui --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`
      - `cargo clippy -p ocean-surface-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`
      - `cargo test -p ocean-surface-proxy`
      - `cargo clippy -p ocean-surface-proxy --all-targets -- -D warnings`
      - `trunk build --release`
      - `./scripts/build-extension.sh`
      - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
      - `git diff --check`
      - verify `git diff --cached --quiet`

## Files to Modify

- `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs` — projection wire types, atomic attachment sequencing, reducers, cursor validation, stream ownership, reset/fallback handling.
- `crates/ocean-surface-proxy/src/main.rs` — projection SSE route and `Last-Event-ID` forwarding.
- `AGENTS.md` — session attachment and separate canvas-lane invariants.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — only if needed to keep existing transport documentation current.

## New Files

- None. Keep the integration localized to the existing daemon adapter and proxy.

## Dependencies

1. Task 1’s daemon component-state ambiguity must be resolved before Surface treats `projection.state.components` as authoritative.
2. Wire types and cursor parsing precede attachment reduction.
3. Stream ownership cleanup precedes opening projection and canvas sources.
4. Atomic snapshot installation precedes projection tail work.
5. Proxy resume forwarding must land before browser/PWA live acceptance.
6. Tests and documentation follow the final wire behavior.

## Risks

- **Blocker:** Current daemon folded component state starts empty per epoch and is not visibly seeded from canonical checkpoint components. Surface cannot distinguish “no component events this epoch” from “authoritative empty registry.”
- Native `EventSource` manages reconnection internally. Gloo suppresses connection errors while native ready state is `CONNECTING`; closing on that state would defeat `Last-Event-ID` resume.
- The proxy currently does not forward `Last-Event-ID` on `/v1/agent/events`; projection must not repeat that omission.
- A refetch checkpoint can recur at the top level, but that top-level marker is already satisfied by the same GET. Only pending/tail refetch markers restart attachment.
- Permission snapshot state does not grant the decision token. Restored permission cards must remain non-authoritative unless the current surface submitted the turn.
- The separate SurfacePatch lane remains best-effort unless its independent canvas-ledger cursor is implemented separately.

- **Correct:** `switch_session` now retires the previous generation before fetching and atomically installs the projection snapshot before opening tails (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3338-3347`, `3589-3623`).
- **Correct:** Voice Planner readiness remains restricted to the legacy agent and permission streams (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:1258-1260`, `5012-5023`, `5126-5134`).
- **Correct:** The canvas rail subscribes only to `surface_patch`, validates session scope, and does not advance the projection cursor (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3825-3894`).
- **Correct:** Legacy hydration occurs before `connect()` (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3465-3485`).
- **Correct:** Rooms, composer, and IME-related files are unchanged. Focused projection and proxy tests passed.
- **Correct:** The proxy preserves projection query parameters and forwards `Last-Event-ID` (`crates/ocean-surface-proxy/src/main.rs:1127-1150`, `1514-1534`).

- **Blocker — high:** Connecting legacy Planner sources are not owned and therefore cannot be closed immediately on replacement. Agent and permission sources are created at `daemon.rs:2347` and `2547`, but are not stored until after `await_event_source_open` at `2390-2405` and `2571-2585`. `PlannerStreamSources::reset` can only close stored sources (`1275-1282`). A switch during the up-to-five-second connecting wait leaves stale browser EventSources alive, violating explicit close/replace ownership.
- **Blocker — high:** Projection retries are unbounded across generations. After four invalid snapshot attempts, `sync_session_projection` calls `restart_projection` (`daemon.rs:3454-3461`), which increments the generation and immediately spawns another four-attempt cycle (`3362-3374`). A permanently incompatible projection version, malformed payload, or repeated reset can create a continuous GET/restart loop without terminal fallback or meaningful backoff.
- **Blocker — high:** Projection-to-legacy fallback after a tail reset can preserve stale live state. `restart_projection` only resets transports/status (`daemon.rs:3362-3373`), while `install_legacy_snapshot` updates transcript/title/model but does not clear `streaming`, `active_turn_id`, `browser_active`, or pending permissions (`3493-3514`). If projection disappears during resync, a finished turn can remain visibly running after legacy hydration.
- **Blocker — medium:** Projection frames do not verify `MessageEvent.last_event_id()` against `frame.cursor`. The tail destructures the message and decodes only its body (`daemon.rs:3699-3724`). Native EventSource independently resumes from the SSE ID, so an ID/body mismatch can make browser resume position diverge from the reducer cursor. The implementation plan explicitly required this validation.

- **Note:** No browser-level test exercises source closure while `Connecting`, native reconnect/rotation, or reset-driven fallback. Pure reducer/proxy tests cannot attest those lifecycle properties.
- **Note:** The requested root `plan.md` and `progress.md` were absent; the available planner artifact and worker handoff were reviewed instead.

A switch during the up-to-five-second connecting wait leaves stale browser EventSources alive, violating explicit close/replace ownership.

After four invalid snapshot attempts, `sync_session_projection` calls `restart_projection` (`daemon.rs:3454-3461`), which increments the generation and immediately spawns another four-attempt cycle (`3362-3374`). A permanently incompatible projection version, malformed payload, or repeated reset can create a continuous GET/restart loop without terminal fallback or meaningful backoff.
